clips.title: The story
paras: At Aldrassil's roots in Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker studies the corruption spreading through Teldrassil. His work begins with the Webwood spiders and their growing aggression.

Gilshalan Windwalker watches Shadowglen from the stone steps at Aldrassil's entrance. Teldrassil was planted to restore the night elves' lost sanctuary and their harmony with nature, yet signs of spiritual malaise appeared almost at once. Gilshalan studies how the corruption affects the local beasts, beginning with the venomous spiders weaving webs nearby.

Gilshalan studies the Webwood spiders in Shadowthread Cave, north of Shadowglen. Once part of the forest's balance, the spiders have grown hostile and tainted. He sends young novices to gather venom sacs and intact eggs. By studying them, he hopes to learn how the venom has changed and whether the corruption passes through generations or spreads from Teldrassil's soil.
